symbols.name: element
symbols.meaning: An element of the group whose order is taken; in the argument, the product $\prod_\eta y_\eta^{\mu_\eta}$.
symbols.quote: The order of an element $\gamma$ of a multiplicative group is the least positive integer $N$ with $\gamma^N=1$, when such $N$ exists.

symbols.name: order
symbols.meaning: The least positive integer with $\gamma^N=1$, which counts the distinct powers of $\gamma$ before the identity repeats.
symbols.quote: The order of an element $\gamma$ of a multiplicative group is the least positive integer $N$ with $\gamma^N=1$, when such $N$ exists.

symbols.name: number of lengths
symbols.meaning: The number of pairwise coprime lengths $s_1,\dots,s_\nu$ of the source, a count.
symbols.quote: Now let $\nu$ be the number of pairwise coprime lengths $s_1,\dots,s_\nu$ of the source, where $s_\eta$ is the $\eta$-th length, and let $S=\prod_\eta s_\eta$.

symbols.name: length
symbols.meaning: The $\eta$-th of the pairwise coprime lengths, a positive integer.
symbols.quote: Now let $\nu$ be the number of pairwise coprime lengths $s_1,\dots,s_\nu$ of the source, where $s_\eta$ is the $\eta$-th length, and let $S=\prod_\eta s_\eta$.

symbols.name: inverse of prefix product
symbols.meaning: The inverse, modulo $s_\eta$, of the product of the earlier lengths; it is coprime to $s_\eta$.
symbols.quote: Let $\mu_\eta$ be the inverse of $\prod_{\zeta<\eta}s_\zeta$ modulo $s_\eta$, so $\mu_\eta$ is coprime to $s_\eta$.

symbols.name: target variable
symbols.meaning: The $\eta$-th variable of the ring of the target monomials.
symbols.quote: Multiplying monomials adds the exponents of each $y_\eta$ modulo $s_\eta$, so $G$ is a multiplicative group with $S$ elements.
